# Bundled browser dependencies

These files are served locally; no CDN is needed at runtime.

- [htmx.org 2.0.8](https://www.npmjs.com/package/htmx.org/v/2.0.8); license: 0BSD.
- [tabulator-tables 6.3.1](https://www.npmjs.com/package/tabulator-tables/v/6.3.1); license: MIT.
- [Quill 2.0.3](https://www.npmjs.com/package/quill/v/2.0.3); license: BSD-3-Clause (`quill.LICENSE`). `quill.js` and `quill.snow.css` are unmodified distribution files from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/quill@2.0.3/dist/.
